cost_items_unknown_no_value.name: cost_items_unknown_no_value
cost_items_unknown_no_value.value: coalesce("cost_items"."fau"::text, '') <> 'unknown' or ("cost_items"."amount" is null and "cost_items"."percent" is null)

cost_items_ranges.name: cost_items_ranges
cost_items_ranges.value: ("cost_items"."amount" is null or "cost_items"."amount" >= 0) and ("cost_items"."percent" is null or ("cost_items"."percent" >= 0 and "cost_items"."percent" <= 1))

evidence_links_one_source.name: evidence_links_one_source
evidence_links_one_source.value: ("evidence_links"."research_log_entry_id" is not null) <> ("evidence_links"."url" is not null)

execution_items_due_idx.name: execution_items_due_idx
execution_items_due_idx.where: "execution_items"."due_date" is not null and "execution_items"."deleted_at" is null

invitations_role_required.name: invitations_role_required
invitations_role_required.value: "invitations"."workspace_id" is null or "invitations"."role" is not null
